description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarSyncOperationDiscovery class, which is responsible for analyzing calendar events and determining the necessary synchronization operations (create, update, delete) between source and target calendars in a CRM system. It includes methods for discovering sync operations based on event differences, handling conflict resolution, and creating synchronization operation objects.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOperationDiscovery
classes.description: Class responsible for discovering synchronization operations between source and target calendar events based on various criteria and conflict resolution strategies.

methods.name: discoverSyncOperations
methods.description: Main method that compares source and target calendar events, determines needed create, update, or delete operations, and returns a list of synchronization operations.

methods.name: createSyncOperation
methods.description: Helper method for creating instances of CalendarSyncOperation with specified parameters.
